purpose: Isolate whether the native WEAPP WebGL Mars disc samples the pinned USGS Viking JPEG rather than only displaying a plain phase globe
environment: Official WeChat DevTools source-project simulator; MEMORY_TEST sample spot, real BSC/planet geometry and local Mars publication; no phone

input.action: search Mars, locate, then repeat the same three native Canvas two-finger pinches in each run

control.treatment: Temporarily pass null for the Mars texture argument only at the existing planet render call; retain the same source, report, mode, camera, phase shader and visual tint

conclusion: Within the official simulator, the pinned JPEG contributes native GPU pixels only inside the resolved Mars globe. The control also confirms the plain phase/tint fallback remains visible. This does not establish map-feature registration on the globe, natural color, Android/iOS composition or image quality, frame time, peak memory, or production cloud delivery.
